label: Time
note: BDF required column.

label: Voltage
note: BDF required column.

label: Current
note: BDF documents positive = charge. This schema does NOT inherit that as an assumption: test_run.current_sign records the convention per run, because ionworksdata uses the opposite sign under the same column name.

label: Cycle number
note: BDF carries a single cycle count. This schema stores cycle_index_as_reported AND cycle_index_derived, because no two cyclers agree on when a cycle increments.

label: Temperature
note: BDF separates ambient / surface / t1..t5. This schema additionally binds each to a sensor entity with a mount location, which BDF has no concept of.

label: AC internal resistance
note: BDF has a single AC resistance column with no frequency, SOC or temperature. Those are required conditions here, so a BDF value alone cannot be promoted to an observation without them.

label: DC internal resistance
note: Same issue, worse: DC resistance without a pulse duration is uninterpretable, and 2 s / 10 s / 18 s / 30 s are all in standard use.

label: Pressure
note: BDF separates ambient / applied / surface pressure.

label: Capacity
note: BDF carries cumulative charge/discharge capacity per record. It has no concept of a rated capacity under stated conditions - that is metadata, and the metadata format does not exist yet.

label: Cycle life
note: Out of scope for a time-series format.

label: Capacity
note: BPX nominal capacity carries no rate or temperature; this schema requires them.

label: Electrode area
note: BPX does not state which area definition; this schema requires area_kind.

label: Specific heat capacity
note: BPX stores a single scalar. Measured specific heat is SOC-dependent (~6% between 50% and 100% SOC), so this schema requires soc_pct.

label: Entropic coefficient
note: BPX places this per-particle; sign convention is not stated.

label: Open circuit voltage
note: BPX OCP is per-electrode (with separate lithiation/delithiation branches and a hysteresis decay constant); this quantity is full-cell OCV.

label: DC internal resistance
note: BPX is explicitly physics-model-only and has NO equivalent-circuit schema. There is no ECM standard anywhere in the field. bd.ecm_parameter_point is this project's proposal: R0 and RC branches as a lookup surface over (SOC, temperature, direction, pulse duration) with mandatory fit provenance.

label: Capacity
note: Annex XIII rated capacity. Legally required from 18 Feb 2027.

label: Round-trip efficiency
note: The Regulation specifies round-trip efficiency at 50% SOC but does not fix the measurement boundary; condition_set.boundary and auxiliaries_included capture what the Regulation leaves open.

label: DC internal resistance
note: The Regulation requires "internal resistance (ohms)" with NO method specified. Expect incomparable values across manufacturers unless the method is captured separately - which is what this schema does.

label: State of health
note: Capacity-based, resistance-based and blended SOH are different numbers.

label: Self-discharge rate
note: Four incommensurable metrics are all called self-discharge; the Regulation does not say which.

label: Mass
note: Mass basis (with or without wrap, terminals, coolant) is unstated in the Regulation and varies between manufacturers.

label: Capacity
note: IRI resolved at build time from electrochemistry.ttl.

label: Capacity retention
note: Ours is a fraction of the reference capacity; EMMO's is the capacity itself.

label: Charge cutoff voltage
note: EMMO's limit is a window bound; ours is the charge termination voltage, which is the same value on a datasheet.

label: Discharge cutoff voltage
note: No lower-limit class in the published ontology.

label: Electrode area
note: EMMO has no electrode-area quantity; the area_kind condition carries which area is meant.

label: Ohmic resistance (EIS)
note: The high-frequency real-axis intercept; EMMO has no dedicated class.

label: Thermal runaway onset temperature
note: EMMO models the process, not the onset temperature.

label: Service life
note: Service life against a stated load, schedule and cutoff; EMMO's term does not carry the load.

label: Temperature
note: Stored in kelvin as SI, quoted in Celsius by every source.

label: Through-plane thermal conductivity
note: EMMO's is scalar; ours is the through-plane component of a tensor (docs/02-conventions.md section 20).

label: Usable energy
note: Usable energy is the stored energy the boundary and depth of discharge allow out; the boundary condition carries the rest.
